name: Bewerbo
description: An Android app that turns a profile entered in the user's own language into a German Bewerbungsmappe — Lebenslauf and Anschreiben, DIN 5008, exported as one PDF. Kotlin/Compose client, C# .NET 10 Minimal API backend.

notes: PostgreSQL is the product database, but with no ConnectionStrings:Bewerbo configured the same DbContext falls back to a SQLite file next to the binary. Nothing needs installing to run it.
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or Anthropic:ApiKey) to use claude-opus-5 for the German. Without it a complete rule-based writer runs instead and GET /api/health reports writer=regeln.

The one architectural rule: the model does not lay out the document. Llm/OutputSchemas.cs contains NO layout field and AssertNoLayoutFields() enforces that at startup and in a unit test. Layout lives only in Rendering/.

No emoji in any user-facing string. EmojiFreeStringsTest scans every values*/strings.xml and fails the build. Those files are declared as inputs of the test task in app/build.gradle.kts — without that declaration Gradle reports the test UP-TO-DATE and skips exactly the commit that adds one.
testTagsAsResourceId is set ONCE at the Compose root in MainActivity. Dialogs and dropdown menus render in their own windows and inherit nothing, so each carries Modifier.exposeTestTags() of its own.
Compose testTags surface to a driver as BARE resource-ids ('overview_readiness_ring'), not as 'de.bewerbo.app:id/...'. Matching on the package-prefixed form finds nothing.
The German terms of art — Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Anforderungsabgleich, DIN 5008, Anlagen, Mappe, anabin — stay German in every locale. Only the surrounding UI chrome is translated.
The Floskel and 'wirkt maschinell' checks must stay rule-based. A model grading its own letter always passes itself.
An anabin/ZAB equivalence is never written into a document unless the user confirmed it.
local.properties is not committed. On Windows write it as 'sdk.dir=C\:/Android/Sdk' — a Java properties file eats the backslashes in 'C:\Android\Sdk'.

Start order: emulator, poll 'adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed' until 1, then 'appium --port 4723', then start the app with 'adb shell monkey -p de.bewerbo.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1'.
Never run 'adb shell pm clear de.bewerbo.app' with an ARIA session open: it kills the uiautomator2 instrumentation and ARIA then holds a dead session id that no retry recovers.
android/drive.sh is a fallback driver over adb (resolve by resource-id, tap the centre of its bounds) for when the ARIA session is unavailable.
